# Projects and conversations

## Conversations

A **conversation** is one chat with Mini-Me. Everything in it — your questions, the answers, your
files and the results — stays together, and Mini-Me remembers what was said earlier when you
ask follow-up questions.

**To start a new conversation:** click the **+** button at the top of the left sidebar and
choose **New conversation**.

**To go back to an old one:** click it in the **Conversations** tab, or type a few words in the
search box to find it.

**To rename or delete a conversation:** point at it in the sidebar, click the **⋮** menu next to
it, and choose **Rename** or **Delete**.

![A conversation's menu](images/projects-conversation-menu.png)

::: {.callout-warning}
**Deleting cannot be undone.** It removes the conversation, its chat history and every file it
produced.
:::

## Projects

A **project** groups several conversations about the same topic — for example, *"Sweet potato
drought study"*. All conversations in a project share the project's **mission** and progress
list, and their files are kept together in one folder.

**To create a project:** click **+** at the top of the sidebar → **New project…**, then type a
name.

**To put a conversation into a project:** open the conversation, press **`Ctrl+P`**, choose
**Put this conversation in a project**, and pick the project.

**To start a new conversation inside a project:** in the **Projects** tab, open the project's
**⋮** menu and choose **New conversation in *project name***.

**Other options** in the project's **⋮** menu:

- **Open folder** — opens the project's folder in Windows File Explorer.
- **Delete project** — permanently deletes the project, *all* its conversations and its whole
  folder (including any files you put there yourself). There is no undo.

![The Projects tab](images/projects-tab.png)

## The mission

At the top of the [Pinboard](results.qmd) is the **Mission**: one or two sentences saying what
the project is about. Mini-Me reads it **every time** you ask something, so a clear mission
gives better answers.

- If you don't write one, Mini-Me takes it from your **first question**.
- **To change it:** click the mission text (or the pencil ✏️ next to *Mission*), type the new
  text, and press **Enter** to save. Press **Esc** to cancel.

![Editing the mission](images/projects-mission-edit.png)

Under the mission you will see **Completed** (✓, work already done) and **Pending** (○, work
still to do), which Mini-Me keeps up to date as you go.

## Where your files are saved

Everything Mini-Me makes is saved as normal files in your **Documents** folder:

```
Documents\Mini-Me\
```

Each conversation has its own folder there (inside its project's folder, if it belongs to one).
To open the current conversation's folder, click the **Local Workspace** link near the top of
the chat. You can open these files with your usual programs (Excel, Word, a PDF reader…), copy them, or
back them up like any other file.

![Local Workspace](images/local-workspace.png)
